_help: Fill the 'kits' list below, then run:  cd backend && node scripts/seed-kits.js
Each kit = one branch + one semester. Shape of one entry (copy it into 'kits'):
'branch': a branch CODE from your branches table, or null for a kit that applies to EVERY branch (for example a shared first year).
'item_type': must match an item type name exactly (the script lists the valid names if one is wrong). 'quantity' and 'optional' are optional.
Only you can decide what each semester needs. This file is intentionally empty: no invented lists.
